A heartbreaking moment has emerged from the devastating floods in Nepal after a woman was rescued by the Nepal Army from a flood-hit area. After being brought to safety, she was seen sitting in shock, struggling to process the destruction around her. She had survived the dangerous floodwaters, but the disaster had left her facing the painful reality of losing everything she had. The emotional scene reflects the devastating impact of the floods on ordinary families across Nepal. For many survivors, escaping the water is only the beginning of a long and difficult journey to rebuild their lives. I usually don’t share these moments from when I travel for obvious reasons… I spent a month in Nepal last year, I was going on an evening walk and these little girls were following me asking for money. I decided to take them shopping instead.  It’s such a privilege to be able to travel, and giving back doesn’t have to be so complicated. Yes you can go on volunteer trips or find local charities but I love to just give a little extra when the opportunity arises.
